description: This file contains unit tests for the AcknowledgementsAdapter class within the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter.acknowledgements package. It tests conversion between Acknowledgements objects and Adaptable objects, focusing on acknowledgment labels, statuses, headers, and payloads.

classes.name: AcknowledgementsAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AcknowledgementsAdapter, implementing ProtocolAdapterTest. Contains test methods for conversion between Adaptable and Acknowledgements objects.

methods.name: initConstants
methods.description: Initializes static constants used in tests, particularly the topic path for acknowledgements.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of AcknowledgementsAdapter before each test.

methods.name: acknowledgementsContaining1FromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests converting an Adaptable with one acknowledgment into an Acknowledgements object.

methods.name: acknowledgementsContaining1ToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests converting an Acknowledgements object with one acknowledgment into an Adaptable.

methods.name: acknowledgementsContaining2successAndErrorFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests converting an Adaptable with mixed acknowledgments into an Acknowledgements object.

methods.name: acknowledgementsContaining2successAndErrorToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests converting an Acknowledgements object with mixed acknowledgments into an Adaptable.

methods.name: acknowledgementsContaining2bothSuccessFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests converting an Adaptable with two successful acknowledgments into an Acknowledgements object.

methods.name: acknowledgementsContaining2bothSuccessToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests converting an Acknowledgements object with two successful acknowledgments into an Adaptable.

methods.name: acknowledgementsContaining3FromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests converting an Adaptable with three acknowledgments, including payloads, into an Acknowledgements object.

methods.name: acknowledgementsContaining3ToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests converting an Acknowledgements object with three acknowledgments into an Adaptable.
